arxiv-2303-14480.title: GANTEE: Generative Adversatial Network for Taxonomy Entering Evaluation
arxiv-2303-14480.creator: Zhouhong Gu, Sihang Jiang, Jingping Liu, Yanghua Xiao, Hongwei Feng, Zhixu Li, Jiaqing Liang, Jian Zhong
arxiv-2303-14480.description: Abstract Taxonomy is formulated as directed acyclic concepts graphs or trees that support many downstream tasks. Many new coming concepts need to be added to an existing taxonomy. The traditional taxonomy expansion task aims only at finding the best position for new coming concepts in the existing taxonomy. arxiv-2405-00475.title: Restarts delay escape over a potential barrier
arxiv-2405-00475.creator: R. K. Singh
arxiv-2405-00475.description: Abstract In the barrier escape problem, a random searcher starting at the energy minima tries to escape the barrier under the effect of thermal fluctuations. If the random searcher is subject to successive restarts at the bottom of the well, then its escape over the barrier top is delayed compared to the time it would take in absence of restarts.

arxiv-2406-05952.title: Angular momentum transport via gravitational instability in the Elias 2-27 disc
arxiv-2406-05952.creator: C. Longarini, G. Lodato, C. J. Clarke, J. Speedie, T. Paneque-Carreño, E. Arrigoni, P. Curone, C. Toci, C. Hall
arxiv-2406-05952.description: Abstract Gravitational instability is thought to be one of the main drivers of angular momentum transport in young protoplanetary discs. The disc around Elias 2-27 offers a unique example of gravitational instability at work. It is young and massive, displaying two prominent spiral arms in dust continuum emission and global non-axisymmetric kinematic signatures in molecular line data.

arxiv-2409-12784.title: Evaluating Image Hallucination in Text-to-Image Generation with Question-Answering
arxiv-2409-12784.creator: Youngsun Lim, Hojun Choi, Hyunjung Shim
arxiv-2409-12784.description: Abstract Despite the impressive success of text-to-image (TTI) generation models, existing studies overlook the issue of whether these models accurately convey factual information. In this paper, we focus on the problem of image hallucination, where images created by generation models fail to faithfully depict factual content.

arxiv-2501-03682.title: Asymmetric Variability: The Impact of Uneven Stochasticity on Competitive Dynamics
arxiv-2501-03682.creator: Ori Turkia and Nadav M. Shnerb
arxiv-2501-03682.description: Abstract Competition between species and genotypes is a dominant factor in a variety of ecological and evolutionary processes. Biological dynamics are typically highly stochastic, and therefore, analyzing a competitive system requires accounting for the random nature of birth and death processes (demographic stochasticity) as well as the variability of external conditions (environmental stochasticity).

pmc-10672396.creator: Konrad Tolksdorf, Stefan Schultze-Mosgau, Collin Jacobs, Stephanie Tietz, Christoph-Ludwig Hennig, Luca Testarelli
pmc-10672396.description: Patients with geroderma osteodysplasticum (GO) often times have dentofacial deformities and benefit from orthognathic surgery. pmc-10952827.title: Sites and mechanisms of action of colokinetics at dopamine, ghrelin and serotonin receptors in the rodent lumbosacral defecation centre
pmc-10952827.creator: Mitchell T Ringuet, Ada Koo, Sebastian G B Furness, Stuart J McDougall, John B Furness
pmc-10952827.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). AbstractAgonists of dopamine D2 receptors (D2R), 5‐hydroxytryptamine (5‐HT, serotonin) receptors (5‐HTR) and ghrelin receptors (GHSR) activate neurons in the lumbosacral defecation centre, and act as ‘colokinetics’, leading to increased propulsive colonic motility, in vivo. In the present study, we investigated which neurons in the lumbosacral defecation centre express the receptors and whether dopamine, serotonin and ghrelin receptor agonists act on the same lumbosacral preganglionic neurons (PGNs).

pmc-11344856.creator: Ping Cui, Dengli Li, Leyao Shi, Hongxia Yan, Tianhang Li, Chen Liu, Wei Wang, Haiyan Zheng, Na Ding, Xiaohui Li, Ran Li, Yunrong Shi, Xiaoqing Wang, Hongjun Fu, Ying Qiu, Ruoyu Li, Dongmei Shi
pmc-11344856.description: This study aims to illustrate epidemiology of comorbid CVD in the real-world clinical setting of patients with psoriasis in China. Psoriasis was clinically diagnosed following the national guidelines.

pmc-11500308.creator: Tomislav Rožić, Matthew S Teynor, Nađa Došlić, David M Leitner, Gemma C Solomon
pmc-11500308.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). The kinetics of many chemical reactions can be readily explained with a statistical approach, for example, using a form of transition state theory and comparing calculated Gibbs energies along the reaction coordinate(s). However, there are cases where this approach fails, notably when the vibrational relaxation of the molecule to its statistical equilibrium occurs on the same time scale as the reaction dynamics, whether it is caused by slow relaxation, a fast reaction, or both.

pmc-13079091.title: Early experiments in the making of Moravian ceramics in North Carolina c. 1770–1820
pmc-13079091.creator: Zuzanna Sarnecka, Letizia Bonizzoni, Johanna M. Brown, Jedrzej Sarnecki, Chiara Mazzocchi
pmc-13079091.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The Moravian community settled in North Carolina in 1753, and local ceramic production soon began in Bethabara, with the opening of the first pottery workshop in 1756. However, by 1771, the main ceramic activity had moved to Salem. This study examines the exploratory approach to raw materials that characterised the work of the first two master potters: Gottfried Aust (1722–1788), who was trained in Europe, and Rudolf Christ (1750–1833), who trained under Aust.
